verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first financial infrastructure platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only shows that APIs and a Dashboard exist and give access to data. Nothing documents API tokens, permission scopes, or least-privilege credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
